rc_30.description: 10 Mils thick protective layer, damp-proofing coating, or bituminous coating applied over the full foundation wall height from subfloor ledge to footing bottom.
excludes: Open concrete slabs (Perron beton / dalle sur grade)
Unheated porches on piers or posts (Poteaux)
Exterior stairs (Escaliers exterieurs)
Roof overhangs and soffits (Debord de toit / Corniche)
Deck posts and cantilevered balconies without a full-height backfilled foundation wall
takeoff_guidelines: ALWAYS MEASURE OVERALL EXTERIOR BUILDING FOOTPRINT MASS: full overall building exterior dimensions enclosing all units combined extracted directly from drawing dimension callouts.
CALCULATE USING FULL FOUNDATION HEIGHT: measure total vertical height of poured concrete foundation wall down to the footing base (e.g. wall height + footing thickness).
REJECT INTERIOR ROOM AND UNIT PARTITIONS: strictly ignore individual interior room or unit partition dimensions. Never use single-room sizes as building perimeter.
EXCLUSION CHECKLIST: exclude open concrete slabs (Perron béton), unheated porches on posts/piers (Poteaux), exterior stairs, and deck posts outside the moisture envelope.
CALCULATION: Area (SQ FT) = perimeter_linear_feet * full_foundation_height.

delta_ms.description: Dimpled plastic drainage membrane applied to exterior backfilled foundation walls below grade from finished grade line to footing base.
excludes: Open concrete slabs (Perron beton / dalle sur grade / slab-on-grade)
Unheated porches on piers or posts (Poteaux) or slab-on-grade
Exterior stairs (Escaliers exterieurs)
Roof or soffit overhangs (Debord de toit / Corniche / gallery soffit)
Deck posts or wood decks (Poteaux de terrasse)
Cantilevered balconies without a full-height below-grade foundation wall
takeoff_guidelines: ALWAYS MEASURE OVERALL EXTERIOR BUILDING FOOTPRINT MASS: full overall building exterior dimensions enclosing all units combined extracted directly from drawing dimension callouts.
CALCULATE USING BELOW-GRADE DEPTH: vertical distance from finished grade (Sol / terrain fini) to the footing top/base.
REJECT INTERIOR ROOM AND UNIT PARTITIONS: strictly ignore individual interior room or unit partition dimensions. Never use single-room sizes as building perimeter.
EXCLUSION CHECKLIST: exclude open concrete slabs (Perron béton), unheated porches on posts/piers (Poteaux), exterior stairs, and deck posts outside the moisture envelope.
CALCULATION: Area (SQ FT) = perimeter_linear_feet * below_grade_depth.

delta_flash.description: Termination bar or capping profile used to secure the top edge of the Delta-MS membrane along the perimeter of the foundation wall.
excludes: Open concrete slabs (Perron beton / dalle sur grade)
Unheated porches on piers or posts (Poteaux)
Exterior stairs (Escaliers exterieurs)
Roof overhangs and soffits (Debord de toit)
Deck posts and cantilevered balconies without a full-height backfilled foundation wall
takeoff_guidelines: ALWAYS MEASURE OVERALL EXTERIOR BUILDING FOOTPRINT MASS: full overall building exterior dimensions enclosing all units combined extracted directly from drawing dimension callouts.
CALCULATE AS LINEAR LENGTH: Length (LF) = perimeter_linear_feet with specified waste factor (default 5%).
REJECT INTERIOR ROOM AND UNIT PARTITIONS: strictly ignore individual interior room or unit partition dimensions. Never use single-room sizes as building perimeter.
EXCLUSION CHECKLIST: exclude open concrete slabs (Perron béton), unheated porches on posts/piers (Poteaux), exterior stairs, and deck posts outside the moisture envelope.

geotextile_drain.description: Non-woven filter fabric wrapped around the perforated French drain pipe and crushed stone envelope along the foundation perimeter.
excludes: Open concrete slabs without French drains
Interior drainage systems unless specified on foundation detail
takeoff_guidelines: ALWAYS MEASURE OVERALL EXTERIOR FOUNDATION FOOTPRINT PERIMETER for the continuous drain run.
READ FRENCH DRAIN DETAIL SECTION on typical section sheets (e.g. A401, A501) to dynamically calculate geotextile wrap girth around the crushed stone envelope.
CALCULATION: Area (SQ FT) = perimeter_linear_feet * geotextile_drain_girth.
